title: The job queue keys work by (documentId, scope, branch) but serializes execution per document, so two scopes of one document never run concurrently
description: Jobs for different documents run in parallel; jobs for one document run sequentially even across scopes and branches. Ordering, retry with error history and queueHint dependencies are its work.
